innovation:language.name: Language
innovation:language.description: All survivors gain the **Encourage** survival action.

innovation:inner-lantern.name: Inner Lantern
innovation:inner-lantern.description: The settlement finds the light within. All survivors gain the **Surge** survival action.

innovation:lantern-oven.name: Lantern Oven
innovation:lantern-oven.description:
By agitating lanterns, a source of **Heat** becomes available to the settlement.
**Departing Survivors** gain +1 survival.

innovation:clan-of-death.name: Clan of Death
innovation:clan-of-death.description:
The enduring strength of your clan passes through generations.
All newborn survivors gain:
+1 Accuracy +1 Strength +1 Evasion

prompts.q: You may spend 1 survival and roll again.

innovation:partnership.name: Partnership
innovation:partnership.description: **Partner - "(Partner's Name)"**: When you both **Arrive**, gain survival up to the survival limit. Partners may only nominate each other for [story] **Intimacy**. When a partner dies, the remaining partner gains a random disorder and loses this ability.

action:partnership.name: Partnership
action:partnership.description: Nominate two survivors. They pair off, and each gains the **Partner** ability. A survivor may be nominated for Partnership once per lifetime.

innovation:heart-flute.name: Heart Flute
innovation:heart-flute.description: When a survivor uses the **Synchronized Strike** fighting art, their attack assist may spend 1 survival to change any monster [reaction] to a [reaction] **FAILURE** before any wound attempts are made. Limit once per attack.

prompts.q: *You play a trill note.* Select any Nemesis monster. Add a **Special Showdown** with them (at the highest level you have not yet faced) to the timeline this year. You cannot endeavor here again this phase.

innovation:petal-spiral.name: Petal Spiral
innovation:petal-spiral.description: Regardless of their Hunt XP, survivors may select Sword for their Weapon Proficiency.

prompts.q: Lose 1 Flower resource. If you do, gain the **Flower Addiction** disorder and roll again. Otherwise, nothing happens.

action:choreia.name: **Spider Dance** - Nominate a male and a female survivor and roll 1d10

prompts.q: If both survivors depart this settlement phase, the male survivor gains the **Harvestman** fighting art.

The female survivor devours the male. The male survivor is dead. The female survivor gains half of the male's Hunt XP (rounded down), one of their fighting arts, and the **Death Touch** secret fighting art.

innovation:morgue.name: Morgue
innovation:morgue.description:
By creating a radiative chamber, a source of **Cooling** becomes available to the settlement.

If the settlement has **Cannibalize**, it harvests preserved bodies. At the start of the develop step, gain 1 random basic resource for every 10 survivors in your death count, rounded down.
